components.name: 目前風最強的測站
components.short_desc: 10 分鐘平均風速最大的 15 個測站
components.long_desc: 資料來自中央氣象署氣象站與自動站。依蒲福風級，每秒 10.8 公尺以上為 6 級強風，17.2 以上為 8 級，24.5 以上為 10 級。地圖模式可看風場動畫，資料為氣象署每 6 小時發布的數值預報，線條越長越亮代表風越強。
components.use_case: 颱風或東北季風來時，看哪裡風最大、風往哪吹。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.name || '（' || coalesce(c.short_name, '') || coalesce(s.town, '') || '）' AS x_axis, o.wind_ms AS data
FROM data.weather_obs_current o
JOIN ref.weather_station s USING (station_id)
LEFT JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = s.county_code
WHERE o.wind_ms IS NOT NULL AND o.observed_at >= now() - interval '90 minutes'
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
ORDER BY o.wind_ms DESC, s.name
LIMIT 15

SELECT s.name || '（' || coalesce(c.short_name, '') || coalesce(s.town, '') || '）' AS x_axis, o.wind_ms AS data

JOIN ref.weather_station s USING (station_id)

components.name: 各縣市天氣預報
components.short_desc: 各縣市目前時段的預報最高溫
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署每天 5、11、17、23 時發布未來 36 小時預報，每 12 小時一個時段。縣市模式顯示接下來三個時段的最高溫與最低溫。
components.use_case: 出門前看天氣，決定要不要帶傘、穿多少。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (county_code) *
  FROM data.county_forecast
  WHERE ends_at > now() AND starts_at < now() + interval '12 hours'
  ORDER BY county_code, starts_at
)
SELECT county_code, max_temp_c AS data
FROM cur
ORDER BY county_code

SELECT f.starts_at AS x_axis, t.name AS y_axis, t.v AS data
FROM data.county_forecast f
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('最高溫', f.max_temp_c), ('最低溫', f.min_temp_c)) AS t(name, v)
WHERE f.county_code = :county AND f.ends_at > now() AND f.starts_at < now() + interval '36 hours'

components.name: 颱風路徑
components.short_desc: 颱風的路徑、預報範圍與最大風速
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署發布的實際路徑、未來 120 小時的預報位置，以及 70% 機率的預報範圍。地圖上另有七級風與十級風暴風圈。沒有颱風時無資料。
components.use_case: 掌握颱風的位置、強度與可能路徑。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT typhoon_id, ty_no, coalesce(name_zh, name_en, typhoon_id) AS name
  FROM data.typhoon WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '6 hours'
), edition AS (
  SELECT f.typhoon_id, max(f.issued_at) AS issued_at
  FROM data.typhoon_fix f JOIN active USING (typhoon_id)
  WHERE f.kind = 'forecast' GROUP BY f.typhoon_id
), fixes AS (
  SELECT f.typhoon_id, f.kind, f.valid_at, f.max_wind_ms
  FROM data.typhoon_fix f
  JOIN active a USING (typhoon_id)
  LEFT JOIN edition e USING (typhoon_id)
  WHERE f.max_wind_ms IS NOT NULL
    AND (f.kind = 'analysis' OR f.issued_at = e.issued_at)
), anchor AS (
  -- 預報線從最後一筆實際資料接下去，除非預報本身已經有這個時間（或更早）的點
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (x.typhoon_id) x.typhoon_id, 'forecast' AS kind, x.valid_at, x.max_wind_ms
  FROM fixes x
  WHERE x.kind = 'analysis'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixes f WHERE f.typhoon_id = x.typhoon_id AND f.kind = 'forecast')
  ORDER BY x.typhoon_id, x.valid_at DESC
)
SELECT p.valid_at AS x_axis, a.name || CASE p.kind WHEN 'analysis' THEN '（實際）' ELSE '（預報）' END AS y_axis,
       p.max_wind_ms AS data
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM fixes
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n.* FROM anchor n
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fixes f
                    WHERE f.typhoon_id = n.typhoon_id AND f.kind = 'forecast' AND f.valid_at <= n.valid_at)
) p
JOIN active a USING (typhoon_id)
ORDER BY 1, 2

map_layers.title: 70% 機率預報範圍
map_layers.geojson_sql:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT typhoon_id, ty_no, coalesce(name_zh, name_en, typhoon_id) AS name
  FROM data.typhoon WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '6 hours'
), edition AS (
  SELECT f.typhoon_id, max(f.issued_at) AS issued_at
  FROM data.typhoon_fix f JOIN active USING (typhoon_id)
  WHERE f.kind = 'forecast' GROUP BY f.typhoon_id
), latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.typhoon_id) f.*
  FROM data.typhoon_fix f JOIN active USING (typhoon_id)
  WHERE f.kind = 'analysis' ORDER BY f.typhoon_id, f.valid_at DESC
),
circles AS (
  SELECT f.typhoon_id, f.forecast_hour AS h, ST_Buffer(f.geom::geography, greatest(coalesce(f.radius70_km, 0), 1) * 1000)::geometry AS c
  FROM data.typhoon_fix f JOIN edition e ON e.typhoon_id = f.typhoon_id AND f.kind = 'forecast' AND f.issued_at = e.issued_at
  UNION ALL
  SELECT typhoon_id, 0, ST_Buffer(geom::geography, 1000)::geometry FROM latest
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT typhoon_id, c, lead(c) OVER (PARTITION BY typhoon_id ORDER BY h) AS n FROM circles
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Union(ST_ConvexHull(ST_Collect(p.c, p.n))), 4) AS geometry, a.name, '70% 機率預報範圍' AS label
FROM pairs p JOIN active a USING (typhoon_id)
WHERE p.n IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.typhoon_id, a.name

  FROM data.typhoon_fix f JOIN active USING (typhoon_id)
  WHERE f.kind = 'analysis' ORDER BY f.typhoon_id, f.valid_at DESC
),
pts AS (
  SELECT typhoon_id, 0 AS h, geom FROM latest
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.typhoon_id, f.forecast_hour, f.geom
  FROM data.typhoon_fix f JOIN edition e ON e.typhoon_id = f.typhoon_id AND f.kind = 'forecast' AND f.issued_at = e.issued_at
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_MakeLine(p.geom ORDER BY p.h), 4) AS geometry, a.name, '預報路徑' AS label
FROM pts p JOIN active a USING (typhoon_id)
GROUP BY a.typhoon_id, a.name

map_layers.title: 颱風位置
map_layers.geojson_sql:
WITH active AS (
  SELECT typhoon_id, ty_no, coalesce(name_zh, name_en, typhoon_id) AS name
  FROM data.typhoon WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '6 hours'
), edition AS (
  SELECT f.typhoon_id, max(f.issued_at) AS issued_at
  FROM data.typhoon_fix f JOIN active USING (typhoon_id)
  WHERE f.kind = 'forecast' GROUP BY f.typhoon_id
), latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (f.typhoon_id) f.*
  FROM data.typhoon_fix f JOIN active USING (typhoon_id)
  WHERE f.kind = 'analysis' ORDER BY f.typhoon_id, f.valid_at DESC
),
warning AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.ty_no) w.ty_no, w.alert, w.sections
  FROM data.typhoon_warning w JOIN active a ON a.ty_no = w.ty_no
  WHERE w.effective_at >= now() - interval '6 hours'
  ORDER BY w.ty_no, w.effective_at DESC
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(f.geom, 4) AS geometry, a.name,
       CASE WHEN f.kind = 'forecast' THEN '預報 ' || f.forecast_hour || ' 小時後' WHEN f.valid_at = l.valid_at THEN '目前位置' ELSE '過去位置' END AS kind,
       to_char(f.valid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'MM/DD HH24:MI') AS time,
       f.pressure_hpa, f.max_wind_ms, f.max_gust_ms, f.radius7_km, f.radius10_km, f.radius70_km, f.note,
       CASE WHEN f.valid_at = l.valid_at AND f.kind = 'analysis' THEN w.alert END AS alert,
       CASE WHEN f.valid_at = l.valid_at AND f.kind = 'analysis'
            THEN (SELECT s->>'value' FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.sections) s WHERE s->>'title' = '颱風動態') END AS trend
FROM data.typhoon_fix f
JOIN active a USING (typhoon_id)
JOIN latest l USING (typhoon_id)
LEFT JOIN edition e USING (typhoon_id)
LEFT JOIN warning w ON w.ty_no = a.ty_no
WHERE (f.kind = 'analysis' AND (extract(hour FROM f.valid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int % 6 = 0 OR f.valid_at = l.valid_at))
   OR (f.kind = 'forecast' AND f.issued_at = e.issued_at)
ORDER BY f.kind, f.valid_at

components.use_case: 避開積淹水的路段。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT coalesce(c.short_name, '') || '｜' || s.name || '｜' || round(f.depth_cm) || ' 公分（'
       || to_char(f.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'HH24:MI') || '）' AS x_axis, NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.flood_current f
JOIN ref.flood_sensor s USING (station_code)
LEFT JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = s.county_code
WHERE f.depth_cm >= 10 AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
ORDER BY f.depth_cm DESC, s.name
LIMIT 30

SELECT coalesce(c.short_name, '') || '｜' || s.name || '｜' || round(f.depth_cm) || ' 公分（'
       || to_char(f.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'HH24:MI') || '）' AS x_axis, NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.flood_current f
JOIN ref.flood_sensor s USING (station_code)
LEFT JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = s.county_code
WHERE f.depth_cm >= 10 AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
ORDER BY f.depth_cm DESC, s.name
LIMIT 30

components.name: 積淹水感測器數走勢
components.short_desc: 近一週積淹水感測器數的變化
components.long_desc: 每小時取積淹水 10 公分以上感測器數的最大值。資料來自經濟部水利署與縣市政府的淹水感測器。
components.use_case: 觀察豪雨颱風期間積淹水的變化。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT h.hour AS x_axis, '積淹水感測器' AS y_axis, max(h.flooded) AS data
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', f.observed_at) AS hour, f.observed_at, sum(f.flooded) AS flooded
  FROM data.flood_county_history f
  WHERE f.observed_at >= :from AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR f.county_code = :county)
  GROUP BY f.observed_at
) h
GROUP BY h.hour
ORDER BY 1

SELECT h.hour AS x_axis, '積淹水感測器' AS y_axis, max(h.flooded) AS data
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('hour', f.observed_at) AS hour, f.observed_at, sum(f.flooded) AS flooded
  FROM data.flood_county_history f
  WHERE f.observed_at >= :from AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR f.county_code = :county)
  GROUP BY f.observed_at
) h
GROUP BY h.hour
ORDER BY 1

components.name: 颱風重點數字
components.short_desc: 這次颱風的重點數字
components.long_desc: 統計期間從第一報颱風警報到解除。包含近中心最大風速、停班停課的縣市數、累計收容人次，以及同一時間最多的停電戶數。
components.use_case: 快速了解這次颱風的影響。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
),
nums AS (
  SELECT
    round(extract(epoch FROM ev.t - ev.f) / 3600) AS hours,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM data.typhoon_warning w WHERE w.ty_no = ev.ty_no AND w.effective_at BETWEEN ev.f AND ev.t) AS warnings,
    (SELECT max(x.max_wind_ms) FROM data.typhoon_fix x WHERE x.typhoon_id = ev.typhoon_id AND x.kind = 'analysis') AS wind,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT c.county_code) FROM data.work_closure c
      WHERE c.level >= 1 AND c.day BETWEEN (ev.f AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date AND (ev.t AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date) AS closed,
    (SELECT coalesce(sum(r.refugees_total), 0) FROM data.shelter_report r WHERE r.opened_at BETWEEN ev.f AND ev.t) AS sheltered,
    (SELECT coalesce(max(o.total), 0) FROM (SELECT sum(h.households) AS total FROM data.power_outage_history h
      WHERE h.observed_at BETWEEN ev.f AND ev.t GROUP BY h.observed_at) o) AS outage
  FROM ev
)
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM nums,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '警報期間（小時）', nums.hours), (2, '颱風警報（報）', nums.warnings),
                 (3, '近中心最大風速（公尺/秒）', nums.wind), (4, '曾停班停課的縣市', nums.closed),
                 (5, '累計收容（人次）', nums.sheltered), (6, '停電最多（戶）', nums.outage)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
ORDER BY s.n

components.name: 颱風強度變化
components.short_desc: 這次颱風的最大風速與中心氣壓變化
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署每次發布的颱風位置。地圖模式可看完整路徑，每 6 小時一個點。
components.use_case: 回顧颱風的路徑與強度。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT x.valid_at AS x_axis, '近中心最大風速' AS y_axis, x.max_wind_ms AS data
FROM data.typhoon_fix x
WHERE x.typhoon_id = :typhoon AND x.kind = 'analysis' AND x.max_wind_ms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

map_layers.title: 颱風路徑
map_layers.geojson_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_MakeLine(x.geom ORDER BY x.valid_at), 4) AS geometry, '實際路徑' AS label
FROM data.typhoon_fix x JOIN ev USING (typhoon_id)
WHERE x.kind = 'analysis'
HAVING count(*) > 1

map_layers.title: 颱風位置
map_layers.geojson_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
)
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(x.geom, 4) AS geometry,
       to_char(x.valid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'MM/DD HH24:MI') AS time,
       x.pressure_hpa, x.max_wind_ms, x.max_gust_ms, x.radius7_km, x.radius10_km, x.note
FROM data.typhoon_fix x JOIN ev USING (typhoon_id)
WHERE x.kind = 'analysis' AND extract(hour FROM x.valid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::int % 6 = 0
ORDER BY x.valid_at

components.name: 颱風警報
components.short_desc: 這次颱風的每一報警報
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署發布的海上、海上陸上與解除警報，最新的在最上面。
components.use_case: 回顧警報發布的經過。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
)
SELECT coalesce('第 ' || w.warning_no || ' 報｜', '') || w.alert || '（'
       || to_char(w.effective_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'MM/DD HH24:MI') || '）'
       || coalesce(E'\n警戒區域：' || nullif(array_to_string(w.areas, '、'), ''), '') AS x_axis, NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.typhoon_warning w JOIN ev ON w.ty_no = ev.ty_no AND w.effective_at BETWEEN ev.f - interval '1 minute' AND ev.t
ORDER BY w.effective_at DESC

components.name: 停班停課
components.short_desc: 這次颱風各縣市的停班停課
components.long_desc: 統計期間從第一報颱風警報到解除。地圖依最嚴重的一天上色，縣市模式列出每天的情形。
components.use_case: 回顧哪些縣市停班停課、停了幾天。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.county_code, c.day) c.*
  FROM data.work_closure c, ev
  WHERE c.day BETWEEN (ev.f AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date AND (ev.t AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  ORDER BY c.county_code, c.day, c.announced_at DESC
)
SELECT county_code, max(level) AS data
FROM latest
GROUP BY county_code
ORDER BY county_code

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
),
latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.county_code, c.day) c.*
  FROM data.work_closure c, ev
  WHERE c.day BETWEEN (ev.f AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date AND (ev.t AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  ORDER BY c.county_code, c.day, c.announced_at DESC
)
SELECT to_char(day, 'MM/DD') || ' ' || status AS x_axis, level AS data
FROM latest
WHERE county_code = :county
ORDER BY day

components.name: 颱風期間累積雨量
components.short_desc: 這次颱風各縣市的最大累積雨量
components.long_desc: 統計期間從第一報颱風警報到解除，每個縣市取累積雨量最多的測站，單位為毫米。
components.use_case: 回顧颱風帶來的雨量與降雨集中的地區。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
),
acc AS (
  SELECT h.station_id, sum(h.past1hr_mm) AS mm
  FROM data.rain_obs_history h, ev
  WHERE h.observed_at > ev.f AND h.observed_at <= ev.t AND h.past1hr_mm >= 0
  GROUP BY h.station_id
)
SELECT s.county_code, round(max(a.mm)) AS data
FROM acc a JOIN ref.rain_station s USING (station_id)
WHERE s.county_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.county_code
ORDER BY s.county_code

WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
),
acc AS (
  SELECT h.station_id, sum(h.past1hr_mm) AS mm
  FROM data.rain_obs_history h, ev
  WHERE h.observed_at > ev.f AND h.observed_at <= ev.t AND h.past1hr_mm >= 0
  GROUP BY h.station_id
)
SELECT s.name || coalesce('（' || s.town || '）', '') AS x_axis, round(a.mm) AS data
FROM acc a JOIN ref.rain_station s USING (station_id)
WHERE s.county_code = :county
ORDER BY a.mm DESC
LIMIT 15

components.name: 累積雨量最多的測站
components.short_desc: 這次颱風累積雨量最多的 15 個測站
components.long_desc: 統計期間從第一報颱風警報到解除，累積雨量為每小時雨量的加總。
components.use_case: 找出颱風雨量最集中的地方。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
),
acc AS (
  SELECT h.station_id, sum(h.past1hr_mm) AS mm
  FROM data.rain_obs_history h, ev
  WHERE h.observed_at > ev.f AND h.observed_at <= ev.t AND h.past1hr_mm >= 0
  GROUP BY h.station_id
)
SELECT s.name || '（' || coalesce(c.short_name, '') || coalesce(s.town, '') || '）' AS x_axis, round(a.mm) AS data
FROM acc a JOIN ref.rain_station s USING (station_id)
LEFT JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = s.county_code
ORDER BY a.mm DESC
LIMIT 15

components.name: 停電戶數高峰
components.short_desc: 這次颱風各縣市的最多停電戶數
components.long_desc: 統計期間從第一報颱風警報到解除。台電在災害期間每小時公布停電戶數，取同一次公布中的最大值。
components.use_case: 回顧颱風造成的停電規模。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
),
snap AS (
  SELECT h.observed_at, h.county_code, sum(h.households) AS total
  FROM data.power_outage_history h, ev
  WHERE h.observed_at BETWEEN ev.f AND ev.t AND h.county_code IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY h.observed_at, h.county_code
)
SELECT county_code, max(total) AS data
FROM snap
GROUP BY county_code
ORDER BY county_code

components.name: 收容人次
components.short_desc: 這次颱風各縣市的累計收容人次
components.long_desc: 統計期間從警報前一天到解除警報，加總各縣市通報的收容人次。
components.use_case: 回顧撤離與收容的規模。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
)
SELECT r.county_code, sum(coalesce(r.refugees_total, r.refugees, 0)) AS data
FROM data.shelter_report r, ev
WHERE r.opened_at BETWEEN ev.f - interval '1 day' AND ev.t AND r.county_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.county_code
ORDER BY r.county_code

components.name: 鐵路停駛與通阻
components.short_desc: 這次颱風期間的臺鐵、高鐵停駛與通阻
components.long_desc: 列出颱風警報期間的臺鐵與高鐵營運公告，資料來自交通部 TDX。
components.use_case: 回顧颱風對鐵路的影響。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.typhoon_id, e.ty_no, e.year, e.starts_at AS f, coalesce(e.ends_at, now()) AS t
  FROM data.typhoon_event e WHERE e.typhoon_id = :typhoon
)
SELECT CASE a.operator WHEN 'TRA' THEN '臺鐵' ELSE '高鐵' END || '｜' || a.title || '（'
       || to_char(coalesce(a.published_at, a.first_seen_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'MM/DD HH24:MI') || '）'
       || coalesce(E'\n' || left(a.description, 160), '') AS x_axis, NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.rail_alert a, ev
WHERE coalesce(a.published_at, a.first_seen_at) <= ev.t AND coalesce(a.ends_at, a.last_seen_at) >= ev.f
ORDER BY coalesce(a.published_at, a.first_seen_at) DESC

components.name: 土石流警戒
components.short_desc: 各縣市土石流與崩塌警戒的村里數
components.long_desc: 農業部農村發展及水土保持署依雨量預報發布。黃色警戒表示預計達到警戒值，紅色警戒表示已達到，應撤離。資料經國家災害防救科技中心轉發。
components.use_case: 住在山區或要上山的人，確認是否需要撤離或改行程。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT left(ar->>'geocode', 5)::char(5) AS county_code, count(*) AS data
FROM data.disaster_alert_active a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.areas) ar
WHERE a.kind = 'debris_flow' AND left(ar->>'geocode', 5) IN (SELECT code FROM ref.county)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ar->>'desc' || '（' || coalesce(a.level, '') || '）' AS x_axis, 1 AS data
FROM data.disaster_alert_active a
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(a.areas) ar
WHERE a.kind = 'debris_flow' AND left(ar->>'geocode', 5) = :county
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 30

components.name: 近期有感地震
components.short_desc: 近 30 天最新的 15 次有感地震
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署的顯著有感與小區域有感地震報告，單位為芮氏規模。地圖上圓點越大代表規模越大。報告為速報結果，之後可能修正。
components.use_case: 地震後查看震央、規模與各地震度。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT to_char(e.origin_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'MM/DD') || ' ' || coalesce(substring(e.location from '位於([^)]+)'), e.location, '') AS x_axis, e.magnitude AS data
FROM data.earthquake e
WHERE e.origin_time >= now() - interval '30 days' AND e.magnitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY e.origin_time DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT to_char(e.origin_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'MM/DD') || ' ' || coalesce(substring(e.location from '位於([^)]+)'), e.location, '') AS x_axis, e.magnitude AS data
FROM data.earthquake e
JOIN data.earthquake_intensity i ON i.report_id = e.report_id AND i.county_code = :county
WHERE e.origin_time >= now() - interval '30 days' AND e.magnitude IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY e.origin_time DESC
LIMIT 15

map_layers.title: 近 30 天震央
map_layers.geojson_sql:
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(e.geom, 4) AS geometry, e.report_id, e.content, e.magnitude, e.depth_km,
       e.max_intensity, to_char(e.origin_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS time,
       CASE e.kind WHEN 'significant' THEN '顯著有感地震' ELSE '小區域有感地震' END AS kind
FROM data.earthquake e
WHERE e.geom IS NOT NULL AND e.origin_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM data.earthquake_intensity i WHERE i.report_id = e.report_id AND i.county_code = :county))
ORDER BY e.magnitude

components.name: 各縣市近 30 天有感地震次數
components.short_desc: 近 30 天各縣市震度 1 級以上的地震次數
components.long_desc: 依中央氣象署地震報告中各縣市的最大震度計算。
components.use_case: 比較各地最近地震的頻繁程度。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.code AS county_code, count(e.report_id) AS data
FROM ref.county c
LEFT JOIN data.earthquake_intensity i ON i.county_code = c.code AND i.intensity_rank >= 1
LEFT JOIN data.earthquake e ON e.report_id = i.report_id AND e.origin_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY c.code
ORDER BY c.code

map_layers.title: 各縣市近 30 天有感次數

components.name: 各縣市近 7 天最大震度
components.short_desc: 近 7 天各縣市感受到的最大震度
components.long_desc: 依中央氣象署地震報告中各縣市的最大震度計算。5 弱與 5 強都算 5 級，6 弱與 6 強都算 6 級。0 表示近 7 天沒有有感地震。
components.use_case: 地震後一眼看出哪些縣市搖得最大。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.code AS county_code,
       coalesce(max(CASE WHEN q.intensity_rank >= 9 THEN 7 WHEN q.intensity_rank >= 7 THEN 6 WHEN q.intensity_rank >= 5 THEN 5 ELSE q.intensity_rank END), 0) AS data
FROM ref.county c
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT i.county_code, i.intensity_rank
  FROM data.earthquake_intensity i
  JOIN data.earthquake e ON e.report_id = i.report_id
  WHERE e.origin_time >= now() - interval '7 days'
) q ON q.county_code = c.code
GROUP BY c.code
ORDER BY c.code

map_layers.title: 各縣市近 7 天最大震度

components.name: 近 30 天最大震度分布
components.short_desc: 近 30 天有感地震的最大震度分布
components.long_desc: 依中央氣象署震度分級，1 到 7 級，5 級與 6 級再分弱、強。全國模式取每次地震的最大震度。
components.use_case: 看最近的地震多半是輕微搖晃，還是有較強的地震。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT l.label AS x_axis, count(e.report_id) AS data
FROM (VALUES (1, '1級'), (2, '2級'), (3, '3級'), (4, '4級'), (5, '5弱'), (6, '5強'), (7, '6弱'), (8, '6強'), (9, '7級')) AS l(rank, label)
LEFT JOIN data.earthquake e ON e.max_intensity_rank = l.rank AND e.origin_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY l.rank, l.label
HAVING l.rank <= 4 OR count(e.report_id) > 0
ORDER BY l.rank

SELECT l.label AS x_axis, count(e.report_id) AS data
FROM (VALUES (1, '1級'), (2, '2級'), (3, '3級'), (4, '4級'), (5, '5弱'), (6, '5強'), (7, '6弱'), (8, '6強'), (9, '7級')) AS l(rank, label)
LEFT JOIN data.earthquake_intensity i ON i.intensity_rank = l.rank AND i.county_code = :county
LEFT JOIN data.earthquake e ON e.report_id = i.report_id AND e.origin_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY l.rank, l.label
HAVING l.rank <= 4 OR count(e.report_id) > 0
ORDER BY l.rank

components.name: 火災重點數字
components.short_desc: 最新年度的火災件數、死傷與消防到達時間
components.long_desc: 內政部消防署火災資料，每年公布一次，目前為 2024 年。到達時間指從報案到消防車抵達。
components.use_case: 了解火災規模與消防反應速度。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT count(*) AS n, sum(f.deaths) AS d, sum(f.injuries) AS i,
         round(avg(extract(epoch FROM f.arrived_at - f.reported_at) / 60)) AS mins
  FROM data.fire_incident f

ORDER BY l.rpi DESC, x_axis
LIMIT 15

components.name: 用電部門組成
components.short_desc: 最近一個月各部門的用電比例
components.long_desc: 台電每月公布的售電量，分為住宅、服務業、工業、農林漁牧，不含自用發電。
components.use_case: 比較工業縣市與住商縣市的用電差異。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT CASE s.sector WHEN 'residential' THEN '住宅' WHEN 'service' THEN '服務業' WHEN 'industry' THEN '工業' ELSE '農林漁牧' END AS x_axis, round(sum(s.kwh) / 1e8, 2) AS data
FROM data.power_sales_month s
WHERE s.month = (SELECT max(month) FROM data.power_sales_month) AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY s.sector
ORDER BY data DESC

SELECT CASE s.sector WHEN 'residential' THEN '住宅' WHEN 'service' THEN '服務業' WHEN 'industry' THEN '工業' ELSE '農林漁牧' END AS x_axis, round(sum(s.kwh) / 1e8, 2) AS data
FROM data.power_sales_month s
WHERE s.month = (SELECT max(month) FROM data.power_sales_month) AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY s.sector
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 每戶住宅用電
components.short_desc: 各縣市每戶平均住宅用電
components.long_desc: 住宅售電量除以年底戶數，單位為度。夏天冷氣用電多，數字會比冬天高。
components.use_case: 比較各地家庭的用電量。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.county_code, round(s.kwh::numeric / p.households) AS data
FROM data.power_sales_month s
JOIN data.population_year p ON p.county_code = s.county_code
  AND p.year = (SELECT max(year) FROM data.population_year)
WHERE s.sector = 'residential' AND s.month = (SELECT max(month) FROM data.power_sales_month)
ORDER BY s.county_code

components.name: 各部門用電趨勢
components.short_desc: 每月各部門用電量的變化
components.long_desc: 台電每月公布的售電量，單位為億度，分為住宅、服務業、工業、農林漁牧。
components.use_case: 看用電的季節變化與長期趨勢。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, CASE s.sector WHEN 'residential' THEN '住宅' WHEN 'service' THEN '服務業' WHEN 'industry' THEN '工業' ELSE '農林漁牧' END AS y_axis,
       round(sum(s.kwh) / 1e8, 2) AS data
FROM data.power_sales_month s
WHERE s.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT s.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, CASE s.sector WHEN 'residential' THEN '住宅' WHEN 'service' THEN '服務業' WHEN 'industry' THEN '工業' ELSE '農林漁牧' END AS y_axis,
       round(sum(s.kwh) / 1e8, 2) AS data
FROM data.power_sales_month s
WHERE s.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 每人每日垃圾量
components.short_desc: 各縣市每人每日垃圾量
components.long_desc: 環境部彙整的一般廢棄物產生量，包含垃圾、資源回收與廚餘，以最近一個完整年度計算，單位為公斤。
components.use_case: 比較各地的垃圾減量成效。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT w.county_code, w.per_capita_kg AS data
FROM data.waste_county w
WHERE w.period_type = 'year' AND w.period = (SELECT max(period) FROM data.waste_county WHERE period_type = 'year')
ORDER BY w.county_code

components.name: 資源回收率
components.short_desc: 各縣市的資源回收率
components.long_desc: 資源回收與廚餘回收量除以一般廢棄物產生量，以最近一個完整年度計算。
components.use_case: 比較各地的回收成效。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.short_name AS x_axis, round(100 * (w.recycled_t + w.food_t) / nullif(w.total_t, 0), 1) AS data
FROM data.waste_county w
JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = w.county_code
WHERE w.period_type = 'year' AND w.period = (SELECT max(period) FROM data.waste_county WHERE period_type = 'year')
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 每月垃圾與回收量
components.short_desc: 每月垃圾、資源回收與廚餘量
components.long_desc: 環境部每月更新，約晚三到四個月，單位為萬公噸。
components.use_case: 看垃圾與回收量的變化，例如年節前後的高峰。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT w.period::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, s.y_axis, round(sum(s.data) / 1e4, 2) AS data
FROM data.waste_county w,
     LATERAL (VALUES ('垃圾', w.garbage_t), ('資源回收', w.recycled_t), ('廚餘', w.food_t)) AS s (y_axis, data)
WHERE w.period_type = 'month' AND w.period >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR w.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT w.period::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, s.y_axis, round(sum(s.data) / 1e4, 2) AS data
FROM data.waste_county w,
     LATERAL (VALUES ('垃圾', w.garbage_t), ('資源回收', w.recycled_t), ('廚餘', w.food_t)) AS s (y_axis, data)
WHERE w.period_type = 'month' AND w.period >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR w.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 即時發電結構
components.short_desc: 目前各種發電方式的發電量
components.long_desc: 台電每 10 分鐘公布的各機組淨發電量，依燃料加總，含民營電廠。儲能充電時不列入。目前只有全國資料。
components.use_case: 看現在的電從哪裡來，再生能源占多少。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT CASE fuel_type WHEN 'gas' THEN '燃氣' WHEN 'coal' THEN '燃煤' WHEN 'oil' THEN '燃油' WHEN 'cogen' THEN '汽電共生' WHEN 'nuclear' THEN '核能' WHEN 'solar' THEN '太陽能' WHEN 'wind' THEN '風力' WHEN 'hydro' THEN '水力' WHEN 'storage' THEN '儲能' WHEN 'other_renewable' THEN '其他再生能源' ELSE fuel_type END AS x_axis,
       net_gen_mw AS data
FROM data.power_gen_by_fuel_current
WHERE net_gen_mw > 0
ORDER BY net_gen_mw DESC
queries.history_sql:
SELECT date_trunc(:step, observed_at, 'Asia/Taipei') AS x_axis,
       CASE fuel_type WHEN 'gas' THEN '燃氣' WHEN 'coal' THEN '燃煤' WHEN 'oil' THEN '燃油' WHEN 'cogen' THEN '汽電共生' WHEN 'nuclear' THEN '核能' WHEN 'solar' THEN '太陽能' WHEN 'wind' THEN '風力' WHEN 'hydro' THEN '水力' WHEN 'storage' THEN '儲能' WHEN 'other_renewable' THEN '其他再生能源' ELSE fuel_type END AS y_axis,
       round(avg(net_gen_mw), 1) AS data
FROM data.power_gen_by_fuel_history
WHERE observed_at >= :from AND observed_at < :to AND fuel_type <> 'storage_load'
GROUP BY 1, fuel_type
ORDER BY 1, fuel_type

components.name: 每日備轉容量率
components.short_desc: 每日尖峰備轉容量率
components.long_desc: 備轉容量率為尖峰供電能力減去尖峰負載，再除以尖峰負載。6% 以下為供電警戒。資料更新到昨天。
components.use_case: 觀察供電是否吃緊。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, '備轉容量率' AS y_axis, reserve_pct AS data
FROM (
  SELECT date, reserve_pct FROM data.power_supply_daily
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date, reserve_pct FROM data.power_peak_daily
  WHERE date > (SELECT coalesce(max(date), '-infinity') FROM data.power_supply_daily)
) d
WHERE date >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  AND date <= (:to::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
ORDER BY date

components.name: 今日用電量與供電能力
components.short_desc: 今天的全國用電量與預估最大供電能力
components.long_desc: 台電每 10 分鐘公布。兩條線越接近，代表供電越吃緊。台電只公布當下數值，歷史資料由本站累積。
components.use_case: 看今天離供電上限還有多少空間。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN :step = 'hour' THEN observed_at ELSE date_trunc(:step, observed_at, 'Asia/Taipei') END AS x_axis,
       s.name AS y_axis, round(avg(s.v)) AS data
FROM data.power_load_history,
     LATERAL (VALUES ('用電量', load_mw), ('預估最大供電能力', fore_supply_mw)) AS s(name, v)
WHERE observed_at >= :from AND observed_at < :to AND s.v IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, s.name
ORDER BY 1, s.name

components.name: 各區用電量
components.short_desc: 北、中、南、東四區目前的用電量
components.long_desc: 台電每 10 分鐘公布的區域用電量。
components.use_case: 比較各區用電規模與一天中的變化。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT region AS x_axis, load_mw AS data
FROM data.power_region_history
WHERE observed_at = (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM data.power_region_history)
ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['北部', '中部', '南部', '東部'], region)
queries.history_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN :step = 'hour' THEN observed_at ELSE date_trunc(:step, observed_at, 'Asia/Taipei') END AS x_axis,
       region AS y_axis, round(avg(load_mw)) AS data
FROM data.power_region_history
WHERE observed_at >= :from AND observed_at < :to
GROUP BY 1, region
ORDER BY 1, array_position(ARRAY['北部', '中部', '南部', '東部'], region)

components.name: 各區電力供需差
components.short_desc: 各區發電量減用電量
components.long_desc: 正值代表該區把電送往其他區，負值代表需要其他區供電。北部通常是負值，靠中南部支援。
components.use_case: 了解「中電北送」的規模。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT region AS x_axis, gen_mw - load_mw AS data
FROM data.power_region_history
WHERE observed_at = (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM data.power_region_history)
ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['北部', '中部', '南部', '東部'], region)
queries.history_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN :step = 'hour' THEN observed_at ELSE date_trunc(:step, observed_at, 'Asia/Taipei') END AS x_axis,
       region AS y_axis, round(avg(gen_mw - load_mw)) AS data
FROM data.power_region_history
WHERE observed_at >= :from AND observed_at < :to
GROUP BY 1, region
ORDER BY 1, array_position(ARRAY['北部', '中部', '南部', '東部'], region)

components.name: 未來電力供需預測
components.short_desc: 未來兩個月的備轉容量率預估
components.long_desc: 台電約每 10 天公布一次，這裡顯示最新一版。
components.use_case: 提前知道哪些日子供電可能吃緊。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT forecast_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, '預估備轉容量率' AS y_axis, reserve_pct AS data
FROM data.power_supply_forecast
WHERE published_on = (SELECT max(published_on) FROM data.power_supply_forecast)
ORDER BY forecast_date

components.name: 再生能源發電量
components.short_desc: 每月再生能源發電量
components.long_desc: 經濟部能源署統計，包含台電、民營電廠與自用發電設備，單位為億度。資料約晚一到兩個月公布。
components.use_case: 看太陽光電與離岸風電的成長，夏天光電多、冬天風電多。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT r.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, CASE r.source WHEN 'solar' THEN '太陽光電' WHEN 'wind_onshore' THEN '陸域風力' WHEN 'wind_offshore' THEN '離岸風力'
       WHEN 'hydro' THEN '慣常水力' WHEN 'geothermal' THEN '地熱' ELSE '生質能與廢棄物' END AS y_axis,
       round(sum(r.gen_mwh) / 1e5, 2) AS data
FROM data.renewable_month r
WHERE r.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  AND r.month <= (:to::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 再生能源組成
components.short_desc: 近 12 個月再生能源的組成
components.long_desc: 經濟部能源署統計，加總最近 12 個月的發電量。
components.use_case: 了解太陽光電、風力與水力各占多少。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT CASE r.source WHEN 'solar' THEN '太陽光電' WHEN 'wind_onshore' THEN '陸域風力' WHEN 'wind_offshore' THEN '離岸風力'
       WHEN 'hydro' THEN '慣常水力' WHEN 'geothermal' THEN '地熱' ELSE '生質能與廢棄物' END AS x_axis, round(sum(r.gen_mwh) / 1e5, 1) AS data
FROM data.renewable_month r
WHERE r.month > (SELECT max(month) FROM data.renewable_month) - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 未來 7 天的停水
components.short_desc: 未來 7 天每天的停水件數
components.long_desc: 統計台灣自來水與臺北自來水的停水公告。搶修通常當天才公告，所以之後幾天多半是計畫性停水。
components.use_case: 提前知道哪幾天可能停水，先儲水。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT to_char(d.day, 'MM/DD') || '（' || (ARRAY['日', '一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六'])[extract(dow FROM d.day)::int + 1] || '）' AS x_axis,
       count(w.case_id) AS data
FROM generate_series((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date + 6, interval '1 day') AS d(day)
LEFT JOIN data.water_outage w
  ON w.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
  AND w.starts_at < (d.day + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'
  AND w.ends_at > d.day AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR w.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY d.day
ORDER BY d.day

SELECT to_char(d.day, 'MM/DD') || '（' || (ARRAY['日', '一', '二', '三', '四', '五', '六'])[extract(dow FROM d.day)::int + 1] || '）' AS x_axis,
       count(w.case_id) AS data
FROM generate_series((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date + 6, interval '1 day') AS d(day)
LEFT JOIN data.water_outage w
  ON w.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
  AND w.starts_at < (d.day + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'
  AND w.ends_at > d.day AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR w.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY d.day
ORDER BY d.day

components.name: 各縣市目前停水
components.short_desc: 各縣市目前正在停水的件數
components.long_desc: 整理台灣自來水與臺北自來水的停水公告，每 30 分鐘更新。金門、連江不在範圍內。實際停水範圍與時間以自來水公司公告為準。
components.use_case: 確認自己所在的縣市有沒有停水。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.code AS county_code, count(w.case_id) AS data
FROM ref.county c
LEFT JOIN data.water_outage w ON w.county_code = c.code
  AND w.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
    AND w.starts_at <= now() AND w.ends_at > now()
    AND (w.daily_from IS NULL OR (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::time BETWEEN w.daily_from AND w.daily_to)
WHERE c.code NOT IN ('09020', '09007')
GROUP BY c.code
ORDER BY c.code

SELECT coalesce(nullif(trim(d.name), ''), '（未標示）') AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM data.water_outage w
LEFT JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(w.district, ',')) AS d(name) ON true
WHERE w.county_code = :county AND w.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
  AND w.starts_at <= now() AND w.ends_at > now()
  AND (w.daily_from IS NULL OR (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::time BETWEEN w.daily_from AND w.daily_to)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis

components.name: 目前停水影響戶數
components.short_desc: 目前停水影響的戶數
components.long_desc: 加總台灣自來水停水公告中的影響戶數。臺北自來水公告沒有戶數，不包含在內。降壓地區不計入。
components.use_case: 比較停水規模。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.name AS x_axis, sum(w.households) AS data
FROM data.water_outage w
JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = w.county_code
WHERE w.source = 'twc' AND w.households IS NOT NULL AND w.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
  AND w.starts_at <= now() AND w.ends_at > now()
  AND (w.daily_from IS NULL OR (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::time BETWEEN w.daily_from AND w.daily_to)
GROUP BY c.name, c.sort_order
ORDER BY data DESC, c.sort_order

SELECT coalesce(w.district, '（未標示）') AS x_axis, sum(w.households) AS data
FROM data.water_outage w
WHERE w.county_code = :county AND w.source = 'twc' AND w.households IS NOT NULL AND w.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '2 hours'
  AND w.starts_at <= now() AND w.ends_at > now()
  AND (w.daily_from IS NULL OR (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::time BETWEEN w.daily_from AND w.daily_to)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis

components.name: 各縣市停電戶數（災害期間）
components.short_desc: 災害期間各縣市的停電戶數
components.long_desc: 台電只在颱風、地震等災害期間每小時公布，平時沒有資料。不含個別用戶停電與計畫性停電。
components.use_case: 災害期間掌握停電規模與復電情形。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.code AS county_code, coalesce(sum(o.households), 0) AS data
FROM ref.county c
LEFT JOIN data.power_outage_current o ON o.county_code = c.code
GROUP BY c.code
ORDER BY c.code

SELECT coalesce(o.district, o.area, '（未標示）') AS x_axis, sum(o.households) AS data
FROM data.power_outage_current o
WHERE o.county_code = :county AND o.households IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis

components.name: 醫事機構類型
components.short_desc: 各類型醫事機構的家數
components.long_desc: 中央健康保險署的健保特約名單，分為醫院、西醫診所、牙醫、中醫與藥局。
components.use_case: 看醫療資源的組成。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN level = 'pharmacy' THEN '健保藥局'
            WHEN level = 'clinic' THEN CASE WHEN kind LIKE '%牙%' THEN '牙醫診所' WHEN kind LIKE '%中醫%' THEN '中醫診所' ELSE '西醫診所' END
            ELSE '醫院' END AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.medical_facility
WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days' AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY data DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN level = 'pharmacy' THEN '健保藥局'
            WHEN level = 'clinic' THEN CASE WHEN kind LIKE '%牙%' THEN '牙醫診所' WHEN kind LIKE '%中醫%' THEN '中醫診所' ELSE '西醫診所' END
            ELSE '醫院' END AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.medical_facility
WHERE last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days' AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 各縣市醫院
components.short_desc: 各縣市健保特約醫院家數
components.long_desc: 中央健康保險署每天更新，分為醫學中心、區域醫院與地區醫院。名單沒有座標，地圖上不顯示位置。
components.use_case: 就醫或搬家時參考各地醫療資源。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT county_code, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.medical_facility
WHERE county_code IS NOT NULL AND last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days' AND level IN ('medical_center', 'regional', 'district')
GROUP BY county_code
ORDER BY county_code

SELECT CASE level WHEN 'medical_center' THEN '醫學中心' WHEN 'regional' THEN '區域醫院' WHEN 'district' THEN '地區醫院' END AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.medical_facility
WHERE county_code = :county AND last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days' AND level IN ('medical_center', 'regional', 'district')
GROUP BY level
ORDER BY min(CASE level WHEN 'medical_center' THEN 1 WHEN 'regional' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END)

components.name: 每萬人醫療院所
components.short_desc: 各縣市每萬人的醫院與診所數
components.long_desc: 健保特約醫院與診所家數，除以縣市戶籍人口，不含藥局。
components.use_case: 比較各地醫療資源是否足夠。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT m.county_code, round(count(*) * 1e4 / max(p.population), 1) AS data
FROM ref.medical_facility m
JOIN data.population_year p ON p.county_code = m.county_code
WHERE p.year = (SELECT max(year) FROM data.population_year) AND m.level <> 'pharmacy' AND m.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days'
GROUP BY m.county_code
ORDER BY m.county_code

components.long_desc: 中央健康保險署的健保特約名單，包含西醫、牙醫與中醫診所。

queries.chart_sql:

FROM ref.medical_facility

components.name: 登革熱重點數字
components.short_desc: 今年登革熱本土與境外病例，以及近四週新病例
components.long_desc: 疾病管制署確定病例，依發病日與居住地統計，每天更新。本站只保存各鄉鎮每天的病例數，不保存個案資料。
components.use_case: 本土病例增加時，記得清除積水容器、防蚊。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(o.cases) FILTER (WHERE NOT o.imported AND o.onset_date >= date_trunc('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date), 0) AS local,
         coalesce(sum(o.cases) FILTER (WHERE o.imported AND o.onset_date >= date_trunc('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date), 0) AS imported,
         coalesce(sum(o.cases) FILTER (WHERE o.onset_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date - 28), 0) AS recent,
         count(DISTINCT o.county_code) FILTER (WHERE NOT o.imported AND o.onset_date >= date_trunc('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date) AS counties
  FROM data.dengue_daily o
  WHERE (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR o.county_code = :county)
  HAVING count(*) > 0
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '今年本土病例', t.local), (2, '今年境外移入', t.imported), (3, '最近四週新病例', t.recent), (4, '有本土病例的縣市', t.counties)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE s.data IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.n

SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(o.cases) FILTER (WHERE NOT o.imported AND o.onset_date >= date_trunc('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date), 0) AS local,
         coalesce(sum(o.cases) FILTER (WHERE o.imported AND o.onset_date >= date_trunc('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date), 0) AS imported,
         coalesce(sum(o.cases) FILTER (WHERE o.onset_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date - 28), 0) AS recent,
         count(DISTINCT o.county_code) FILTER (WHERE NOT o.imported AND o.onset_date >= date_trunc('year', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date) AS counties
  FROM data.dengue_daily o
  WHERE (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR o.county_code = :county)
  HAVING count(*) > 0
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '今年本土病例', t.local), (2, '今年境外移入', t.imported), (3, '最近四週新病例', t.recent), (4, '有本土病例的縣市', t.counties)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE s.data IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.n

FROM (
  SELECT sum(v.visits) FILTER (WHERE v.disease = 'ili' AND v.visit_type = 'outpatient') AS ili,

components.name: 今日果菜行情
components.short_desc: 最近一個交易日的蔬果批發均價與交易量
components.long_desc: 農業部彙整全國果菜批發市場行情，依交易量加權平均，單位為元/公斤。這是批發價，不是零售價。休市時沒有資料。
components.use_case: 掌握整體菜價與果價。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT round(sum(f.avg_price * f.volume) FILTER (WHERE f.category = 'vegetable')
               / nullif(sum(f.volume) FILTER (WHERE f.category = 'vegetable'), 0), 1) AS veg,
         round(sum(f.avg_price * f.volume) FILTER (WHERE f.category = 'fruit')
               / nullif(sum(f.volume) FILTER (WHERE f.category = 'fruit'), 0), 1) AS fruit,
         round(sum(f.volume) FILTER (WHERE f.category = 'vegetable') / 1000, 1) AS veg_t,
         round(sum(f.volume) FILTER (WHERE f.category = 'fruit') / 1000, 1) AS fruit_t
  FROM data.farm_price_daily f
  WHERE f.trade_date = (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM data.farm_price_daily WHERE category IN ('vegetable', 'fruit'))
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '蔬菜平均價（元/公斤）', t.veg), (2, '水果平均價（元/公斤）', t.fruit),
                 (3, '蔬菜交易量（公噸）', t.veg_t), (4, '水果交易量（公噸）', t.fruit_t)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE t.veg IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.n

queries.chart_sql:

components.name: 主要水果價格

components.name: 蔬菜漲跌幅
components.short_desc: 主要蔬菜與前一週相比的漲跌幅
components.long_desc: 從交易量最大的 30 種蔬菜中，列出漲跌最多的 12 種。比較基準是前一週依交易量加權的均價。
components.use_case: 找出最近漲最多、跌最多的蔬菜。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT * FROM data.farm_price_daily f
  WHERE f.category = 'vegetable' AND f.trade_date = (SELECT max(trade_date) FROM data.farm_price_daily WHERE category IN ('vegetable', 'fruit'))
  ORDER BY f.volume DESC
  LIMIT 30
),
before AS (
  SELECT b.crop, sum(b.avg_price * b.volume) / nullif(sum(b.volume), 0) AS price
  FROM data.farm_price_daily b JOIN latest l ON l.crop = b.crop AND b.category = 'vegetable'
  WHERE b.trade_date BETWEEN l.trade_date - 8 AND l.trade_date - 1
  GROUP BY b.crop
)
SELECT l.crop AS x_axis, round(100 * (l.avg_price - b.price) / b.price, 1) AS data
FROM latest l JOIN before b USING (crop)
WHERE b.price > 0
ORDER BY abs(l.avg_price - b.price) / b.price DESC
LIMIT 12

components.name: 蛋價與豬價
components.short_desc: 最新的蛋價、雞價與豬價
components.long_desc: 農業部畜牧司每個交易日公布。蛋價單位為元/台斤，豬價為全國肉品市場規格豬的平均拍賣價，單位為元/公斤。
components.use_case: 掌握雞蛋、雞肉與豬肉的行情。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT (SELECT p.egg_farm FROM data.poultry_price p WHERE p.egg_farm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.day DESC LIMIT 1) AS egg,
         (SELECT p.broiler_large FROM data.poultry_price p WHERE p.broiler_large IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.day DESC LIMIT 1) AS broiler,
         (SELECT round(sum(h.price * h.head) / nullif(sum(h.head) FILTER (WHERE h.price IS NOT NULL), 0), 1)
            FROM data.hog_trade h WHERE h.day = (SELECT max(day) FROM data.hog_trade)) AS hog,
         (SELECT sum(h.head) FROM data.hog_trade h WHERE h.day = (SELECT max(day) FROM data.hog_trade)) AS heads
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '雞蛋產地價（元/台斤）', t.egg), (2, '白肉雞 2 公斤以上（元/台斤）', t.broiler), (3, '毛豬平均價格（元/公斤）', t.hog), (4, '毛豬成交頭數', t.heads)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE s.data IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.n

components.name: 蛋價走勢
components.short_desc: 近一年雞蛋產地價與批發價
components.long_desc: 農業部畜牧司公布，單位為元/台斤。產地價是蛋農賣給蛋商的價格，大運輸價是蛋商的批發價。夏天與過年前蛋價通常較高。
components.use_case: 看蛋價的變化。

LATERAL (VALUES ('產地價', p.egg_farm), ('大運輸價', p.egg_transport)) AS s (name, v)

components.name: 毛豬價格走勢
components.short_desc: 近一年全國毛豬平均價格
components.long_desc: 農業部畜牧司公布的全國肉品市場規格豬平均拍賣價，單位為元/公斤。
components.use_case: 看豬價的變化。

queries.chart_sql:

components.long_desc: 農業部畜牧司公布的最新交易日價格，單位為元/公斤。市場名稱為所在地，例如「台中大安」。

components.name: 邊境查驗不合格
components.short_desc: 近 30 天與近一年邊境查驗不合格件數
components.long_desc: 食品藥物管理署公布的不合格輸入食品與食品器具，例如農藥殘留或添加物不符規定。不合格貨品會退運或銷毀，不會上市。
components.use_case: 了解輸入食品的把關情形。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.published_on > current_date - 30) AS m,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.published_on > current_date - 365) AS y,
         count(DISTINCT r.origin) FILTER (WHERE r.published_on > current_date - 365) AS o
  FROM data.food_rejection r
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '最近 30 天（件）', t.m), (2, '最近一年（件）', t.y), (3, '最近一年的產地（國）', t.o)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
ORDER BY s.n

components.name: 最新不合格食品
components.short_desc: 最新公布的邊境查驗不合格食品
components.long_desc: 食品藥物管理署公布，列出最新 20 件。不合格貨品會退運或銷毀，不會上市。
components.use_case: 看最近有哪些輸入食品不合格。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT to_char(r.published_on, 'MM/DD') || '｜' || r.origin || '｜' || r.product
       || E'\n' || r.reason AS x_axis, NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.food_rejection r
ORDER BY r.published_on DESC, r.product
LIMIT 20

components.name: 不合格原因
components.short_desc: 近一年最常見的 10 種不合格原因
components.long_desc: 食品藥物管理署公布的邊境查驗不合格食品，依件數排序。
components.use_case: 看最常見的不合格項目，例如農藥殘留。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT r.reason AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM data.food_rejection r
WHERE r.published_on > current_date - 365
GROUP BY r.reason
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis
LIMIT 10

components.name: 不合格產地
components.short_desc: 近一年不合格件數最多的 10 個產地
components.long_desc: 食品藥物管理署公布的邊境查驗不合格食品，依件數排序。進口量大的產地，件數通常也較多。
components.use_case: 看不合格食品主要來自哪裡。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT r.origin AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM data.food_rejection r
WHERE r.published_on > current_date - 365
GROUP BY r.origin
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis
LIMIT 10

components.name: 每月不合格件數
components.short_desc: 每月邊境查驗不合格件數
components.long_desc: 食品藥物管理署公布，依發布月份計算。
components.use_case: 看不合格件數的變化。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', r.published_on)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis,
       '不合格件數' AS y_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM data.food_rejection r
WHERE r.published_on >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
GROUP BY 1

components.name: 房價重點數字
components.short_desc: 近半年住宅買賣的中位數單價、總價與件數
components.long_desc: 內政部實價登錄，每月 1、11、21 日更新，交易到登錄約有一個多月時間差。只計算住宅買賣，排除親友等特殊關係交易。中位數較不受少數豪宅影響。
components.use_case: 掌握整體房價水準。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.unit_price) * 3.30579 / 1e4)::numeric, 1) AS unit,
         round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.total_price) / 1e4)::numeric) AS total,
         count(*) AS n
  FROM data.real_estate_deal d
  WHERE d.kind = 'sale' AND NOT d.special AND d.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND d.main_use = '住家用'
  AND d.target LIKE '房地%' AND d.building_type ~ '^(住宅大樓|華廈|公寓|透天厝)'
  AND d.deal_date > (SELECT max(deal_date) FROM data.real_estate_deal WHERE kind = 'sale') - interval '6 months' AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR d.county_code = :county)
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '中位數單價（萬元/坪）', t.unit), (2, '中位數總價（萬元）', t.total),
                 (3, '買賣件數（近半年）', t.n)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE t.n > 0
ORDER BY s.n

SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.unit_price) * 3.30579 / 1e4)::numeric, 1) AS unit,
         round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.total_price) / 1e4)::numeric) AS total,
         count(*) AS n
  FROM data.real_estate_deal d
  WHERE d.kind = 'sale' AND NOT d.special AND d.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND d.main_use = '住家用'
  AND d.target LIKE '房地%' AND d.building_type ~ '^(住宅大樓|華廈|公寓|透天厝)'
  AND d.deal_date > (SELECT max(deal_date) FROM data.real_estate_deal WHERE kind = 'sale') - interval '6 months' AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR d.county_code = :county)
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '中位數單價（萬元/坪）', t.unit), (2, '中位數總價（萬元）', t.total),
                 (3, '買賣件數（近半年）', t.n)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE t.n > 0
ORDER BY s.n

components.name: 各縣市房價
components.short_desc: 近半年各縣市住宅中位數單價
components.long_desc: 內政部實價登錄，只計算住宅買賣，單位為萬元/坪。件數少的縣市，例如離島，數字波動較大。
components.use_case: 比較各縣市房價。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT d.county_code, round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.unit_price) * 3.30579 / 1e4)::numeric, 1) AS data
FROM data.real_estate_deal d
WHERE d.kind = 'sale' AND NOT d.special AND d.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND d.main_use = '住家用'
  AND d.target LIKE '房地%' AND d.building_type ~ '^(住宅大樓|華廈|公寓|透天厝)'
  AND d.deal_date > (SELECT max(deal_date) FROM data.real_estate_deal WHERE kind = 'sale') - interval '6 months' AND d.county_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.county_code
HAVING count(*) >= 10
ORDER BY d.county_code

SELECT coalesce(d.district, '（未填）') AS x_axis,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.unit_price) * 3.30579 / 1e4)::numeric, 1) AS data
FROM data.real_estate_deal d
WHERE d.kind = 'sale' AND NOT d.special AND d.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND d.main_use = '住家用'
  AND d.target LIKE '房地%' AND d.building_type ~ '^(住宅大樓|華廈|公寓|透天厝)'
  AND d.deal_date > (SELECT max(deal_date) FROM data.real_estate_deal WHERE kind = 'sale') - interval '6 months' AND d.county_code = :county
GROUP BY 1
HAVING count(*) >= 5
ORDER BY data DESC
LIMIT 30

components.name: 房價走勢
components.short_desc: 近一年每月住宅中位數單價
components.long_desc: 內政部實價登錄，依交易月份計算。尚未登錄完的最近月份不列出。資料保留最近四季。
components.use_case: 看房價的變化趨勢。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT m.x_axis, m.y_axis, m.data
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', d.deal_date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, '中位數單價' AS y_axis,
         round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.unit_price) * 3.30579 / 1e4)::numeric, 1) AS data,
         count(*) AS n, max(count(*)) OVER () AS top
  FROM data.real_estate_deal d
  WHERE d.kind = 'sale' AND NOT d.special AND d.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND d.main_use = '住家用'
    AND d.target LIKE '房地%' AND d.building_type ~ '^(住宅大樓|華廈|公寓|透天厝)'
    AND d.deal_date >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
    AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR d.county_code = :county)
  GROUP BY 1
) m
-- 交易多半在一兩個月內登錄：件數不到最多那個月三成的月份（早期零星的晚登錄、最近還沒登錄完）不列出
WHERE m.n * 10 >= m.top * 3
ORDER BY 1

SELECT m.x_axis, m.y_axis, m.data
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', d.deal_date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, '中位數單價' AS y_axis,
         round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.unit_price) * 3.30579 / 1e4)::numeric, 1) AS data,
         count(*) AS n, max(count(*)) OVER () AS top
  FROM data.real_estate_deal d
  WHERE d.kind = 'sale' AND NOT d.special AND d.unit_price IS NOT NULL AND d.main_use = '住家用'
    AND d.target LIKE '房地%' AND d.building_type ~ '^(住宅大樓|華廈|公寓|透天厝)'
    AND d.deal_date >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
    AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR d.county_code = :county)
  GROUP BY 1
) m
-- 交易多半在一兩個月內登錄：件數不到最多那個月三成的月份（早期零星的晚登錄、最近還沒登錄完）不列出
WHERE m.n * 10 >= m.top * 3
ORDER BY 1

components.name: 預售屋房價
components.short_desc: 近半年各縣市預售屋中位數單價
components.long_desc: 內政部實價登錄的預售屋買賣，單位為萬元/坪。少於 10 件的縣市不列出。
components.use_case: 比較預售屋價格，以及和中古屋的差距。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.short_name AS x_axis,
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.unit_price) * 3.30579 / 1e4)::numeric, 1) AS data

components.name: 租金行情

components.name: 國道車速最慢的路段
components.short_desc: 目前車速最慢的 15 個國道路段
components.long_desc: 交通部高速公路局的路段車速。地圖上綠色為順暢，黃橘色車多，紅色壅塞，灰色為封閉。
components.use_case: 看哪裡在塞車，決定要不要改道或晚點出發。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT replace(replace(s.road_name, '國道', '國'), '號', '') || CASE s.direction WHEN 'N' THEN '北上' WHEN 'S' THEN '南下' WHEN 'E' THEN '東向' WHEN 'W' THEN '西向' ELSE '' END || ' ' ||
       coalesce(s.start_name, '') || '–' || coalesce(s.end_name, '') AS x_axis, c.speed_kmh AS data
FROM data.freeway_traffic_current c
JOIN ref.freeway_section s USING (section_id)
WHERE c.speed_kmh > 0 AND c.observed_at >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
ORDER BY c.speed_kmh, s.name
LIMIT 15

SELECT replace(replace(s.road_name, '國道', '國'), '號', '') || CASE s.direction WHEN 'N' THEN '北上' WHEN 'S' THEN '南下' WHEN 'E' THEN '東向' WHEN 'W' THEN '西向' ELSE '' END || ' ' ||
       coalesce(s.start_name, '') || '–' || coalesce(s.end_name, '') AS x_axis, c.speed_kmh AS data
FROM data.freeway_traffic_current c
JOIN ref.freeway_section s USING (section_id)
WHERE c.speed_kmh > 0 AND c.observed_at >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
ORDER BY c.speed_kmh, s.name
LIMIT 15

map_layers.title: 國道路況
map_layers.geojson_sql:
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(s.geom, 5) AS geometry, s.name || CASE s.direction WHEN 'N' THEN '北上' WHEN 'S' THEN '南下' WHEN 'E' THEN '東向' WHEN 'W' THEN '西向' ELSE '' END AS name, c.speed_kmh, c.level,
       CASE c.level WHEN 1 THEN '順暢' WHEN 2 THEN '車多' WHEN 3 THEN '車多' WHEN 4 THEN '壅塞' WHEN 5 THEN '壅塞'
                    WHEN -1 THEN '道路封閉' END AS level_name,
       to_char(c.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'MM/DD HH24:MI') AS time
FROM ref.freeway_section s
JOIN data.freeway_traffic_current c USING (section_id)
WHERE s.geom IS NOT NULL AND c.observed_at >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)

components.name: 各縣市國道平均車速
components.short_desc: 各縣市國道的平均車速
components.long_desc: 交通部高速公路局路段車速，每 5 分鐘更新，依路段長度加權。80 公里以上為順暢，40 以下為壅塞。
components.use_case: 出發前看國道順不順。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.county_code, round(sum(c.speed_kmh * s.length_km) / sum(s.length_km)) AS data
FROM data.freeway_traffic_current c
JOIN ref.freeway_section s USING (section_id)
WHERE c.speed_kmh > 0 AND s.length_km > 0 AND s.county_code IS NOT NULL AND c.observed_at >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY s.county_code
ORDER BY s.county_code
queries.history_sql:
SELECT date_trunc(:step, c.observed_at, 'Asia/Taipei') AS x_axis, '平均車速' AS y_axis,
       round(sum(c.speed_kmh * s.length_km) / sum(s.length_km)) AS data
FROM data.freeway_traffic_history c
JOIN ref.freeway_section s USING (section_id)
WHERE c.observed_at >= :from AND c.observed_at < :to AND c.speed_kmh > 0 AND s.length_km > 0
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR s.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT replace(replace(s.road_name, '國道', '國'), '號', '') || CASE s.direction WHEN 'N' THEN '北上' WHEN 'S' THEN '南下' WHEN 'E' THEN '東向' WHEN 'W' THEN '西向' ELSE '' END || ' ' ||
       coalesce(s.start_name, '') || '–' || coalesce(s.end_name, '') AS x_axis, c.speed_kmh AS data
FROM data.freeway_traffic_current c
JOIN ref.freeway_section s USING (section_id)
WHERE s.county_code = :county AND c.speed_kmh > 0 AND c.observed_at >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
ORDER BY c.speed_kmh, s.name
LIMIT 15

components.name: 油價走勢
components.short_desc: 中油汽柴油牌價走勢
components.long_desc: 台灣中油 92、95、98 無鉛汽油與超級柴油的參考牌價。圖表顯示近兩年，歷史可查到 1999 年。
components.use_case: 看油價的長期趨勢。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT effective_at AS x_axis, product AS y_axis, price AS data
FROM data.fuel_price
WHERE effective_at >= now() - interval '2 years' AND effective_at <= now()
ORDER BY 1, 2
queries.history_sql:
SELECT date_trunc(:step, effective_at, 'Asia/Taipei') AS x_axis, product AS y_axis, avg(price) AS data

WHERE effective_at >= :from AND effective_at < :to
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 目前油價
components.short_desc: 中油目前的汽柴油牌價
components.long_desc: 通常每週日中午公布，週一凌晨生效。民營加油站價格可能略有不同。
components.use_case: 加油前看油價。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (product) product AS x_axis, price AS data
FROM data.fuel_price
WHERE effective_at <= now()
ORDER BY product, effective_at DESC

components.name: 各縣市中油加油站
components.short_desc: 各縣市中油加油站數
components.long_desc: 台灣中油直營與加盟站，每天更新，不含其他品牌。地圖上可查看營業時間與油品。
components.use_case: 找附近的加油站。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.county_code, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.fuel_station s
WHERE s.operating AND s.county_code IS NOT NULL AND s.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days'
GROUP BY s.county_code
ORDER BY s.county_code

map_layers.title: 中油加油站
map_layers.geojson_sql:

components.name: 加油站服務
components.short_desc: 中油加油站的服務項目
components.long_desc: 統計有自助加油、98 無鉛、超級柴油的站數，以及中油自營站數。不含其他品牌。
components.use_case: 看各地有多少站能自助加油。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.self_service) AS self, count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.has_98) AS u98,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.has_diesel) AS diesel, count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.kind = '自營站') AS direct
  FROM ref.fuel_station st
  WHERE st.operating AND st.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days'
    AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR st.county_code = :county)
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '刷卡自助', t.self), (2, '98 無鉛', t.u98), (3, '超級柴油', t.diesel), (4, '自營站', t.direct)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE t.n > 0
ORDER BY s.n

SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT count(*) AS n, count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.self_service) AS self, count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.has_98) AS u98,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.has_diesel) AS diesel, count(*) FILTER (WHERE st.kind = '自營站') AS direct
  FROM ref.fuel_station st
  WHERE st.operating AND st.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days'
    AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR st.county_code = :county)
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '刷卡自助', t.self), (2, '98 無鉛', t.u98), (3, '超級柴油', t.diesel), (4, '自營站', t.direct)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)

  AND p.year = (SELECT max(year) FROM data.population_year)
WHERE v.month > (SELECT max(month) FROM data.vital_month) - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY v.county_code
ORDER BY v.county_code

components.name: 每月結婚與離婚
components.short_desc: 每月結婚與離婚對數
components.long_desc: 內政部戶政司依登記月份統計。有好日子的月份，例如 5 月 20 日，結婚特別多。
components.use_case: 看結婚與離婚的變化。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT v.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, s.y_axis, sum(s.data) AS data
FROM data.vital_month v,
     LATERAL (VALUES ('結婚', v.marriages), ('離婚', v.divorces)) AS s (y_axis, data)
WHERE v.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR v.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT v.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, s.y_axis, sum(s.data) AS data
FROM data.vital_month v,
     LATERAL (VALUES ('結婚', v.marriages), ('離婚', v.divorces)) AS s (y_axis, data)
WHERE v.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR v.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 各縣市托嬰中心
components.short_desc: 各縣市托嬰中心家數
components.long_desc: 衛生福利部社會福利機構名冊，包含公私立托嬰中心，收托未滿 2 歲幼兒，每月更新。
components.use_case: 找住家或公司附近的托嬰中心。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.county_code, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.childcare_center c
WHERE c.county_code IS NOT NULL AND c.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '40 days'
GROUP BY c.county_code
ORDER BY c.county_code

map_layers.title: 托嬰中心
map_layers.geojson_sql:
SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(c.geom, 5) AS geometry, c.name, c.address,
       CASE WHEN c.name LIKE '%公%' AND c.name NOT LIKE '%私立%' THEN '公立（含公設民營）' ELSE '私立' END AS kind
FROM ref.childcare_center c
WHERE c.geom IS NOT NULL AND c.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '40 days'
  AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR c.county_code = :county)

components.name: 經濟重點數字
components.short_desc: 景氣燈號、物價年增率與失業率
components.long_desc: 景氣對策信號由國家發展委員會每月公布，物價與失業率由行政院主計總處公布。各指標顯示最新月份。
components.use_case: 掌握整體經濟、物價與就業。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT max(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.series = 'signal_score') AS signal,
         max(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.series = 'cpi_yoy:總指數') AS cpi,
         max(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.series = 'cpi_yoy:食物類') AS food,
         max(e.value) FILTER (WHERE e.series = 'unemployment:總計') AS unemployment
  FROM data.econ_month e
  WHERE e.month = (SELECT max(month) FROM data.econ_month x WHERE x.series = e.series)
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '景氣對策信號（分）', t.signal), (2, '物價年增率（%）', t.cpi), (3, '食物類物價年增率（%）', t.food), (4, '失業率（%）', t.unemployment)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE s.data IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.n

components.name: 最近的景氣燈號
components.short_desc: 近 12 個月的景氣燈號
components.long_desc: 國家發展委員會公布。38 分以上紅燈為熱絡，23–31 分綠燈為穩定，16 分以下藍燈為低迷。
components.use_case: 看最近一年的景氣燈號。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT to_char(e.month, 'YYYY/MM') || '｜' || CASE WHEN e.value >= 38 THEN '紅燈' WHEN e.value >= 32 THEN '黃紅燈' WHEN e.value >= 23 THEN '綠燈' WHEN e.value >= 17 THEN '黃藍燈' ELSE '藍燈' END || '（' || e.value::int || ' 分）' AS x_axis,
       NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.econ_month e
WHERE e.series = 'signal_score'
ORDER BY e.month DESC
LIMIT 12

components.name: 景氣對策信號
components.short_desc: 近五年每月景氣對策信號分數
components.long_desc: 國家發展委員會以股價、出口、工業生產、就業等九項指標計分，總分 9 到 45 分。38 分以上為紅燈，16 分以下為藍燈。
components.use_case: 看景氣的循環。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT e.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, '綜合分數' AS y_axis, e.value AS data
FROM data.econ_month e
WHERE e.series = 'signal_score' AND e.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
ORDER BY 1

components.name: 物價年增率走勢
components.short_desc: 近五年每月物價年增率
components.long_desc: 行政院主計總處的消費者物價指數，包含總指數、食物類與外食費，年增率為與去年同月比較。
components.use_case: 看物價的漲跌趨勢。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT e.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, split_part(e.series, ':', 2) AS y_axis, e.value AS data
FROM data.econ_month e
WHERE e.series IN ('cpi_yoy:總指數', 'cpi_yoy:食物類', 'cpi_yoy:外食費')
  AND e.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 各類物價漲幅
components.short_desc: 最新月份七大類物價年增率
components.long_desc: 行政院主計總處分為食物、衣著、居住、交通及通訊、醫藥保健、教養娛樂、雜項。
components.use_case: 看哪一類東西漲最多。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT split_part(e.series, ':', 2) AS x_axis, e.value AS data
FROM data.econ_month e
WHERE e.series IN ('cpi_yoy:食物類', 'cpi_yoy:衣著類', 'cpi_yoy:居住類', 'cpi_yoy:交通及通訊類', 'cpi_yoy:醫藥保健類', 'cpi_yoy:教養娛樂類', 'cpi_yoy:雜項類')
  AND e.month = (SELECT max(month) FROM data.econ_month x WHERE x.series = e.series)
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 食物價格漲幅
components.short_desc: 最新月份各類食物的物價年增率
components.long_desc: 行政院主計總處公布。蔬菜水果受颱風、寒害影響，漲跌幅較大。
components.use_case: 看最近哪些食物變貴。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT split_part(e.series, ':', 2) AS x_axis, e.value AS data
FROM data.econ_month e
WHERE e.series IN ('cpi_yoy:穀類及其製品', 'cpi_yoy:肉類', 'cpi_yoy:肉類製品', 'cpi_yoy:蛋類', 'cpi_yoy:水產品', 'cpi_yoy:加工水產品', 'cpi_yoy:蔬菜', 'cpi_yoy:加工蔬菜', 'cpi_yoy:水果', 'cpi_yoy:加工水果', 'cpi_yoy:乳類', 'cpi_yoy:食用油', 'cpi_yoy:調味品', 'cpi_yoy:酒', 'cpi_yoy:非酒精性飲料及材料', 'cpi_yoy:調理食品', 'cpi_yoy:外食費', 'cpi_yoy:其他食品')
  AND e.month = (SELECT max(month) FROM data.econ_month x WHERE x.series = e.series)
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 失業率走勢
components.short_desc: 近五年每月失業率
components.long_desc: 行政院主計總處人力資源調查，未經季節調整。畢業季 6 到 8 月失業率通常較高。
components.use_case: 看就業市場的變化。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT e.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis,
       CASE split_part(e.series, ':', 2) WHEN '總計' THEN '全體' WHEN '20-24歲' THEN '20–24 歲' ELSE '大學以上' END AS y_axis,
       e.value AS data
FROM data.econ_month e
WHERE e.series IN ('unemployment:總計', 'unemployment:20-24歲', 'unemployment:大學及以上')
  AND e.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 各年齡失業率
components.short_desc: 最新月份各年齡層失業率
components.long_desc: 行政院主計總處人力資源調查。15 到 24 歲的失業率通常是整體的兩到三倍。
components.use_case: 看哪些年齡層比較難找工作。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT replace(split_part(e.series, ':', 2), '-', '–') AS x_axis, e.value AS data
FROM data.econ_month e
WHERE e.series LIKE 'unemployment:%歲%' AND e.month = (SELECT max(month) FROM data.econ_month x WHERE x.series = e.series)
ORDER BY split_part(e.series, ':', 2)

components.name: 各縣市所得
components.short_desc: 各縣市申報戶平均綜合所得
components.long_desc: 財政部財政資訊中心依綜所稅資料統計，約晚兩年半公布，單位為萬元。不含免稅所得與政府補助，不等於家庭收入。
components.use_case: 比較各地的所得水準。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT i.county_code, round(sum(i.income_k)::numeric / sum(i.households) / 10, 1) AS data
FROM data.income_town i
WHERE i.year = (SELECT max(year) FROM data.income_town)
GROUP BY i.county_code
ORDER BY i.county_code

SELECT i.town AS x_axis, round(i.median_k / 10.0, 1) AS data
FROM data.income_town i
WHERE i.year = (SELECT max(year) FROM data.income_town) AND i.county_code = :county
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis

components.name: 所得最高的鄉鎮市區
components.short_desc: 所得中位數最高的 15 個鄉鎮市區
components.long_desc: 財政部財政資訊中心依綜所稅資料統計，約晚兩年半公布。中位數較不受少數高所得者影響。
components.use_case: 看哪些地方所得較高。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.short_name || i.town AS x_axis, round(i.median_k / 10.0, 1) AS data
FROM data.income_town i
JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = i.county_code
WHERE i.year = (SELECT max(year) FROM data.income_town)
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis
LIMIT 15

SELECT i.town AS x_axis, round(i.median_k / 10.0, 1) AS data
FROM data.income_town i
WHERE i.year = (SELECT max(year) FROM data.income_town) AND i.county_code = :county
ORDER BY data, x_axis
LIMIT 15

components.name: 認養重點數字
components.short_desc: 公立收容所開放認養的貓狗數
components.long_desc: 農業部全國動物收容管理系統，每天更新四次。想認養請聯絡收容所，或到全國推廣動物認領養平台。
components.use_case: 了解有多少動物在等待認養。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = '狗') AS dogs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = '貓') AS cats,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.open_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date - 30) AS recent
  FROM data.shelter_animal a
  WHERE (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR a.county_code = :county)
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '開放認養', t.total), (2, '狗', t.dogs), (3, '貓', t.cats), (4, '最近一個月新開放', t.recent)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE s.data IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.n

SELECT s.x_axis, s.data
FROM (
  SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = '狗') AS dogs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.kind = '貓') AS cats,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.open_date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date - 30) AS recent
  FROM data.shelter_animal a
  WHERE (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR a.county_code = :county)
) t,
LATERAL (VALUES (1, '開放認養', t.total), (2, '狗', t.dogs), (3, '貓', t.cats), (4, '最近一個月新開放', t.recent)) AS s (n, x_axis, data)
WHERE s.data IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.n

components.name: 認養動物的種類
components.short_desc: 開放認養動物的種類與年齡
components.long_desc: 分為成犬、幼犬、成貓、幼貓。資料來自農業部全國動物收容管理系統。
components.use_case: 看收容所裡有哪些動物在等家。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN a.kind IN ('狗', '貓') THEN CASE a.age WHEN 'CHILD' THEN '幼' ELSE '成' END
            || CASE a.kind WHEN '狗' THEN '犬' ELSE '貓' END ELSE '其他' END AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM data.shelter_animal a
WHERE (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR a.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY data DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN a.kind IN ('狗', '貓') THEN CASE a.age WHEN 'CHILD' THEN '幼' ELSE '成' END
            || CASE a.kind WHEN '狗' THEN '犬' ELSE '貓' END ELSE '其他' END AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM data.shelter_animal a
WHERE (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR a.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 最新開放認養
components.short_desc: 最新開放認養的 20 隻動物
components.long_desc: 列出收容所、種類、性別、體型與毛色。本站不轉載照片，也不保存拾獲地點。
components.use_case: 看最近有哪些動物可以認養。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT to_char(a.open_date, 'MM/DD') || '｜' || a.shelter || E'\n'
       || concat_ws('・', CASE WHEN a.kind = '其他' THEN a.variety ELSE a.kind || coalesce('（' || nullif(a.variety, '') || '）', '') END,
                    CASE a.sex WHEN 'M' THEN '公' WHEN 'F' THEN '母' END,
                    CASE a.age WHEN 'CHILD' THEN '幼年' WHEN 'ADULT' THEN '成年' END,
                    CASE a.body_type WHEN 'SMALL' THEN '小型' WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN '中型' WHEN 'BIG' THEN '大型' END,
                    a.colour, CASE WHEN a.sterilized THEN '已絕育' END) AS x_axis, NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.shelter_animal a
WHERE a.open_date IS NOT NULL AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR a.county_code = :county)
ORDER BY a.open_date DESC, a.animal_id DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT to_char(a.open_date, 'MM/DD') || '｜' || a.shelter || E'\n'
       || concat_ws('・', CASE WHEN a.kind = '其他' THEN a.variety ELSE a.kind || coalesce('（' || nullif(a.variety, '') || '）', '') END,
                    CASE a.sex WHEN 'M' THEN '公' WHEN 'F' THEN '母' END,
                    CASE a.age WHEN 'CHILD' THEN '幼年' WHEN 'ADULT' THEN '成年' END,
                    CASE a.body_type WHEN 'SMALL' THEN '小型' WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN '中型' WHEN 'BIG' THEN '大型' END,
                    a.colour, CASE WHEN a.sterilized THEN '已絕育' END) AS x_axis, NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.shelter_animal a
WHERE a.open_date IS NOT NULL AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR a.county_code = :county)
ORDER BY a.open_date DESC, a.animal_id DESC
LIMIT 20

components.name: 各縣市開放認養動物
components.short_desc: 各縣市開放認養的動物數
components.long_desc: 農業部全國動物收容管理系統，每天更新四次。
components.use_case: 找附近可以認養動物的收容所。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT a.county_code, count(*) AS data
FROM data.shelter_animal a
WHERE a.county_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.county_code
ORDER BY a.county_code

SELECT a.shelter AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM data.shelter_animal a
WHERE a.county_code = :county
GROUP BY a.shelter
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis

components.name: 收容與認養走勢
components.short_desc: 近兩年每月收容、認領養與所內死亡數
components.long_desc: 農業部公立動物收容所統計，每月更新。認領養包含飼主領回。
components.use_case: 看收容動物的進出變化。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT m.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, s.name AS y_axis, sum(s.n) AS data
FROM data.shelter_month m,
LATERAL (VALUES ('收容', m.accepted), ('認領養', m.adopted), ('所內死亡', m.died)) AS s (name, n)
WHERE m.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR m.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT m.month::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' AS x_axis, s.name AS y_axis, sum(s.n) AS data
FROM data.shelter_month m,
LATERAL (VALUES ('收容', m.accepted), ('認領養', m.adopted), ('所內死亡', m.died)) AS s (name, n)
WHERE m.month >= (:from::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR m.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 各縣市認養率
components.short_desc: 近 12 個月各縣市的認領養率
components.long_desc: 認領養隻數除以收容隻數。因為包含先前收容的動物，有時會超過 100%。
components.use_case: 比較各縣市收容所的認養成效。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.short_name AS x_axis, round(100.0 * sum(m.adopted) / nullif(sum(m.accepted), 0), 1) AS data
FROM data.shelter_month m
JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = m.county_code
WHERE m.month > (SELECT max(month) FROM data.shelter_month) - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY c.short_name
HAVING sum(m.accepted) > 0
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 各縣市所內死亡率
components.short_desc: 近 12 個月各縣市的所內死亡率
components.long_desc: 收容期間因病、受傷或年老死亡的比例，不含人道處理。
components.use_case: 看各縣市收容所的照顧狀況。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.short_name AS x_axis, round(100.0 * sum(m.died) / nullif(sum(m.accepted), 0), 1) AS data
FROM data.shelter_month m
JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = m.county_code
WHERE m.month > (SELECT max(month) FROM data.shelter_month) - interval '12 months'
GROUP BY c.short_name
HAVING sum(m.accepted) > 0
ORDER BY data DESC

components.name: 旅宿類型
components.short_desc: 合法旅宿的類型
components.long_desc: 交通部觀光署名單，分為國際觀光旅館、一般觀光旅館、一般旅館與民宿。
components.use_case: 看各地住宿以飯店還是民宿為主。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT CASE h.class WHEN 1 THEN '國際觀光旅館' WHEN 2 THEN '一般觀光旅館' WHEN 3 THEN '一般旅館' WHEN 4 THEN '民宿' ELSE '其他' END AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.tourism_hotel h
WHERE h.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days' AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR h.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY h.class
ORDER BY h.class

SELECT CASE h.class WHEN 1 THEN '國際觀光旅館' WHEN 2 THEN '一般觀光旅館' WHEN 3 THEN '一般旅館' WHEN 4 THEN '民宿' ELSE '其他' END AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.tourism_hotel h
WHERE h.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days' AND (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR h.county_code = :county)
GROUP BY h.class
ORDER BY h.class

components.name: 各縣市旅館民宿
components.short_desc: 各縣市合法旅館與民宿家數
components.long_desc: 交通部觀光署資料，每天更新。地圖上觀光旅館顏色最深，民宿最淺。
components.use_case: 出遊時確認住宿是合法業者。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT h.county_code, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.tourism_hotel h
WHERE h.county_code IS NOT NULL AND h.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days'
GROUP BY h.county_code
ORDER BY h.county_code

SELECT CASE h.class WHEN 1 THEN '國際觀光旅館' WHEN 2 THEN '一般觀光旅館' WHEN 3 THEN '一般旅館' WHEN 4 THEN '民宿' ELSE '其他' END AS x_axis, count(*) AS data
FROM ref.tourism_hotel h
WHERE h.county_code = :county AND h.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days'
GROUP BY h.class
ORDER BY h.class

map_layers.title: 旅館民宿
map_layers.geojson_sql:

components.short_desc: 各縣市觀光景點數
components.long_desc: 交通部觀光署資料，每天更新，包含自然景觀、古蹟、博物館、休閒農場等。

components.name: 旅宿房間數
components.short_desc: 各縣市合法旅宿房間數
components.long_desc: 交通部觀光署登記的房間總數。民宿通常只有幾間房，觀光旅館可達數百間。
components.use_case: 估計各地能容納多少旅客。

queries.chart_sql:

JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = h.county_code

FROM ref.tourism_hotel h
WHERE h.county_code = :county AND h.last_seen_at >= now() - interval '3 days' AND h.rooms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY h.class
ORDER BY h.class

components.name: 鄉鎮天氣預報
components.short_desc: 各鄉鎮接下來 3 小時的預報氣溫
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署的鄉鎮預報，每 3 小時一個時段，每天更新 8 次。全國模式列出各縣市氣溫最高的鄉鎮，縣市模式列出所有鄉鎮。點地圖上的鄉鎮可以看天氣、體感溫度和降雨機率。
components.use_case: 出門前查所在鄉鎮接下來幾小時的天氣。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (geocode) *
  FROM data.town_forecast
  WHERE ends_at > now()
  ORDER BY geocode, starts_at
),
best AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.county_code) c.short_name || t.name AS x_axis, f.temp_c AS data, c.sort_order
  FROM cur f
  JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
  JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = t.county_code
  WHERE f.temp_c IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY t.county_code, f.temp_c DESC, t.name
)
SELECT x_axis, data
FROM best
ORDER BY data DESC, sort_order

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (geocode) *
  FROM data.town_forecast
  WHERE ends_at > now()
  ORDER BY geocode, starts_at
)
SELECT t.name AS x_axis, f.temp_c AS data
FROM cur f
JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = t.county_code
WHERE t.county_code = :county AND f.temp_c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.temp_c DESC, t.name
LIMIT 40

components.name: 一週天氣預報
components.short_desc: 各縣市明天的預報最高溫
components.long_desc: 取自中央氣象署鄉鎮一週預報，數值是縣市內各鄉鎮的平均。全國模式顯示明天的最高溫，縣市模式顯示未來一週每天的最高溫與最低溫。
components.use_case: 安排週末出遊或這幾天的穿著。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT t.county_code, f.geocode, date_trunc('day', f.starts_at, 'Asia/Taipei') AS day,
         max(f.max_temp_c) AS hi, min(f.min_temp_c) AS lo
  FROM data.town_forecast_week f
  JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
  WHERE f.ends_at > now()
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT county_code, round(avg(hi)) AS data
FROM d
WHERE day = date_trunc('day', now(), 'Asia/Taipei') + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY county_code
ORDER BY county_code

WITH d AS (
  SELECT t.county_code, f.geocode, date_trunc('day', f.starts_at, 'Asia/Taipei') AS day,
         max(f.max_temp_c) AS hi, min(f.min_temp_c) AS lo
  FROM data.town_forecast_week f
  JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
  WHERE f.ends_at > now() AND t.county_code = :county
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT d.day AS x_axis, v.name AS y_axis, round(avg(v.val)) AS data
FROM d
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('最高溫', d.hi), ('最低溫', d.lo)) AS v(name, val)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

components.name: 紫外線預報
components.short_desc: 各縣市白天的紫外線指數預報
components.long_desc: 取自中央氣象署鄉鎮一週預報，只有白天時段有紫外線指數，傍晚以後顯示明天的預報。縣市取鄉鎮中最高的值。分級依世界衛生組織標準：0–2 低量、3–5 中量、6–7 高量、8–10 過量、11 以上危險。
components.use_case: 前一天先知道明天要不要準備防曬。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT min(starts_at) AS s FROM data.town_forecast_week WHERE uvi IS NOT NULL AND ends_at > now()
)
SELECT t.county_code, max(f.uvi) AS data
FROM data.town_forecast_week f
JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
JOIN p ON f.starts_at = p.s
WHERE f.uvi IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.county_code
ORDER BY t.county_code

WITH p AS (
  SELECT min(starts_at) AS s FROM data.town_forecast_week WHERE uvi IS NOT NULL AND ends_at > now()
)
SELECT t.name AS x_axis, f.uvi AS data
FROM data.town_forecast_week f
JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
JOIN p ON f.starts_at = p.s
WHERE t.county_code = :county AND f.uvi IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY f.uvi DESC, t.name

components.name: 今天的潮汐
components.short_desc: 潮差最大的地點與今天滿潮、乾潮的時間
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署潮汐預報，涵蓋沿海鄉鎮、漁港、海水浴場和潛點。潮差是今天最高與最低潮位的差。全國模式列出潮差最大的 15 個地點，縣市模式列出縣市內所有地點。
components.use_case: 去海邊、釣魚或潛水前確認漲退潮時間。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH today AS (
  SELECT f.station_id, max(f.height_cm) - min(f.height_cm) AS range_cm,
         string_agg(CASE f.tide WHEN '滿潮' THEN to_char(f.at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'HH24:MI') END, '、' ORDER BY f.at) AS high,
         string_agg(CASE f.tide WHEN '乾潮' THEN to_char(f.at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'HH24:MI') END, '、' ORDER BY f.at) AS low
  FROM data.tide_forecast f
  WHERE f.at >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Asia/Taipei') AND f.at < date_trunc('day', now(), 'Asia/Taipei') + interval '1 day'
  GROUP BY f.station_id
)
SELECT s.name || '｜潮差 ' || coalesce(d.range_cm || ' 公分', '—') || E'\n' || '滿潮 ' || coalesce(d.high, '—') || '　乾潮 ' || coalesce(d.low, '—') AS x_axis,
       NULL::numeric AS data
FROM today d
JOIN ref.tide_station s USING (station_id)
ORDER BY d.range_cm DESC NULLS LAST, s.name
LIMIT 15

WITH today AS (
  SELECT f.station_id, max(f.height_cm) - min(f.height_cm) AS range_cm,
         string_agg(CASE f.tide WHEN '滿潮' THEN to_char(f.at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'HH24:MI') END, '、' ORDER BY f.at) AS high,
         string_agg(CASE f.tide WHEN '乾潮' THEN to_char(f.at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'HH24:MI') END, '、' ORDER BY f.at) AS low
  FROM data.tide_forecast f
  WHERE f.at >= date_trunc('day', now(), 'Asia/Taipei') AND f.at < date_trunc('day', now(), 'Asia/Taipei') + interval '1 day'
  GROUP BY f.station_id
)
SELECT s.name || '｜潮差 ' || coalesce(d.range_cm || ' 公分', '—') || E'\n' || '滿潮 ' || coalesce(d.high, '—') || '　乾潮 ' || coalesce(d.low, '—') AS x_axis,
       NULL::numeric AS data
FROM today d
JOIN ref.tide_station s USING (station_id)
WHERE s.county_code = :county
ORDER BY s.name
LIMIT 80
