components.name: 日出日沒時刻
components.short_desc: 各縣市今天的日出、日沒、月出與月沒
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署天文資料。縣市模式顯示未來 7 天。沒有月出或月沒的日子顯示為「—」。
components.use_case: 安排看日出、拍夕陽或觀星的時間。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT c.short_name || '｜' || '日出 ' || coalesce(to_char(m.sunrise, 'HH24:MI'), '—') || '　日沒 ' || coalesce(to_char(m.sunset, 'HH24:MI'), '—')
       || E'\n' || '月出 ' || coalesce(to_char(m.moonrise, 'HH24:MI'), '—') || '　月沒 ' || coalesce(to_char(m.moonset, 'HH24:MI'), '—') AS x_axis,
       NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.sun_moon m
JOIN ref.county c ON c.code = m.county_code
WHERE m.date = (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
ORDER BY c.sort_order

SELECT to_char(m.date, 'MM/DD') || '｜' || '日出 ' || coalesce(to_char(m.sunrise, 'HH24:MI'), '—') || '　日沒 ' || coalesce(to_char(m.sunset, 'HH24:MI'), '—')
       || E'\n' || '月出 ' || coalesce(to_char(m.moonrise, 'HH24:MI'), '—') || '　月沒 ' || coalesce(to_char(m.moonset, 'HH24:MI'), '—') AS x_axis,
       NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.sun_moon m
WHERE m.county_code = :county AND m.date >= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')::date
ORDER BY m.date
LIMIT 7

components.name: 海嘯資訊
components.short_desc: 近一年中央氣象署發布的海嘯消息與警報
components.long_desc: 多數是國外大地震的通報，大部分不會影響臺灣。每則消息一列，最新的在最上面。沒有資料代表近一年沒有發布。
components.use_case: 國外發生大地震時，確認臺灣沿海是否受影響。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT to_char(s.issued_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei', 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI') || '｜' || coalesce(s.report_type, '海嘯資訊')
       || ' 第 ' || s.report_seq || ' 報' || coalesce('（' || s.location || coalesce(' 規模 ' || s.magnitude, '') || '）', '')
       || coalesce(E'\n' || s.content, '') AS x_axis,
       NULL::numeric AS data
FROM data.tsunami s
WHERE s.issued_at >= now() - interval '1 year'
ORDER BY s.issued_at DESC
LIMIT 15

components.name: 熱傷害指數
components.short_desc: 各縣市未來 24 小時最高的熱傷害指數
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署健康氣象，數值越高越容易中暑。全國模式顯示各縣市鄉鎮中的最高值，縣市模式列出各鄉鎮。每 3 小時一個時段。
components.use_case: 安排戶外工作、運動或活動前，評估中暑的風險。

queries.chart_sql:
SELECT t.county_code, max(h.index_value) AS data
FROM data.town_health h
JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
WHERE h.kind = 'heat' AND h.ends_at > now() AND h.starts_at < now() + interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY t.county_code
ORDER BY t.county_code

SELECT t.name AS x_axis, max(h.index_value) AS data
FROM data.town_health h
JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
WHERE h.kind = 'heat' AND h.ends_at > now() AND h.starts_at < now() + interval '24 hours' AND t.county_code = :county
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY data DESC, t.name

components.name: 冷傷害指數
components.short_desc: 各縣市今天最低的冷傷害指數
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署健康氣象，數值越低越冷，越容易因低溫引發心血管或呼吸道疾病。全國模式顯示各縣市鄉鎮中的最低值，縣市模式列出各鄉鎮。
components.use_case: 寒流來時提醒家中長輩保暖。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH cur AS (

  FROM data.town_health
  WHERE kind = 'cold' AND ends_at > now()
  ORDER BY geocode, starts_at
)
SELECT t.county_code, min(f.index_value) AS data
FROM cur f
JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
GROUP BY t.county_code
ORDER BY t.county_code

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (geocode) *
  FROM data.town_health
  WHERE kind = 'cold' AND ends_at > now()
  ORDER BY geocode, starts_at
)

FROM cur f
JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
WHERE t.county_code = :county AND f.index_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY data, t.name

components.name: 日夜溫差
components.short_desc: 各縣市今天最大的日夜溫差
components.long_desc: 取自中央氣象署健康氣象的溫差提醒，溫差是預報最高溫減最低溫。全國模式顯示各縣市鄉鎮中的最大值，縣市模式列出各鄉鎮。
components.use_case: 溫差大的日子出門多帶件外套。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (geocode) *
  FROM data.town_health
  WHERE kind = 'temp_diff' AND ends_at > now()
  ORDER BY geocode, starts_at
)
SELECT t.county_code, max(f.max_temp_c - f.min_temp_c) AS data

JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
GROUP BY t.county_code

WITH cur AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (geocode) *
  FROM data.town_health
  WHERE kind = 'temp_diff' AND ends_at > now()
  ORDER BY geocode, starts_at
)

FROM cur f
JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
WHERE t.county_code = :county AND f.max_temp_c IS NOT NULL AND f.min_temp_c IS NOT NULL

components.name: 健康氣象提醒
components.short_desc: 未來 24 小時有熱傷害、冷傷害或溫差提醒的鄉鎮
components.long_desc: 中央氣象署依健康氣象指數發布注意、警戒、危險等提醒。每個縣市的每種提醒一列，等級高的排前面。沒有提醒時無資料。
components.use_case: 看自己住的鄉鎮有沒有提醒。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (h.geocode, h.kind) h.geocode, h.kind, CASE h.warning WHEN '高危險' THEN 4 WHEN '危險' THEN 3 WHEN '警戒' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS rank
  FROM data.town_health h
  WHERE h.warning IS NOT NULL AND h.ends_at > now() AND h.starts_at < now() + interval '24 hours'
  ORDER BY h.geocode, h.kind, rank DESC
), g AS (
  SELECT t.county_code, w.kind, max(w.rank) AS rank, count(*) AS n, string_agg(t.name, '、' ORDER BY t.name) AS towns
  FROM w
  JOIN ref.forecast_town t USING (geocode)
  WHERE (:county::char(5) IS NULL OR t.county_code = :county)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT c.short_name || '｜' || CASE g.kind WHEN 'heat' THEN '熱傷害' WHEN 'cold' THEN '冷傷害' ELSE '溫差' END || ' '

components.short_desc: 今年累積雨量是平年同期的幾成
components.long_desc: 比較中央氣象署有人氣象站今年的累積雨量和平年同期的雨量，100% 代表和平年一樣。每日雨量約晚兩天公布。只有設有人氣象站的縣市有資料。
components.use_case: 判斷今年是乾是濕，搭配水庫蓄水量看缺水風險。

queries.chart_sql:
WITH last AS (
  SELECT max(date) AS d FROM data.rain_daily WHERE rain_mm IS NOT NULL
), ytd AS (
  SELECT r.station_id, sum(r.rain_mm) AS mm
  FROM data.rain_daily r, last
  WHERE r.date >= date_trunc('year', last.d)::date AND r.date <= last.d
  GROUP BY 1
), norm AS (
  SELECT n.station_id, n.station_name,
         sum(CASE WHEN n.month < extract(month FROM last.d) THEN n.rain_mm
                  WHEN n.month = extract(month FROM last.d)
                  THEN n.rain_mm * extract(day FROM last.d) / extract(day FROM date_trunc('month', last.d) + interval '1 month - 1 day')
                  ELSE 0 END) AS mm
  FROM data.climate_normal n, last
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), pct AS (
  SELECT y.station_id, n.station_name, round(100 * y.mm / nullif(n.mm, 0)) AS p
  FROM ytd y
  JOIN norm n USING (station_id)
)
SELECT s.county_code, round(avg(p.p)) AS data
FROM pct p
JOIN ref.weather_station s USING (station_id)
WHERE s.county_code IS NOT NULL AND p.p IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.county_code
ORDER BY s.county_code

WITH m AS (
  SELECT o.station_id, avg(o.temp_c) AS t, count(*) AS n
  FROM data.weather_obs_history o
  WHERE o.station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM data.climate_normal)
    AND o.observed_at >= date_trunc('month', now(), 'Asia/Taipei') AND o.temp_c IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
), d AS (
  SELECT m.station_id, n.station_name, round((m.t - n.temp_mean_c)::numeric, 1) AS diff
  FROM m
  JOIN data.climate_normal n ON n.station_id = m.station_id AND n.month = extract(month FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')
  WHERE m.n >= 24 AND n.temp_mean_c IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.county_code, round(avg(d.diff), 1) AS data
FROM d
JOIN ref.weather_station s USING (station_id)
WHERE s.county_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.county_code
ORDER BY s.county_code

WITH m AS (
  SELECT o.station_id, avg(o.temp_c) AS t, count(*) AS n
  FROM data.weather_obs_history o
  WHERE o.station_id IN (SELECT station_id FROM data.climate_normal)
    AND o.observed_at >= date_trunc('month', now(), 'Asia/Taipei') AND o.temp_c IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
), d AS (
  SELECT m.station_id, n.station_name, round((m.t - n.temp_mean_c)::numeric, 1) AS diff
  FROM m
  JOIN data.climate_normal n ON n.station_id = m.station_id AND n.month = extract(month FROM now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')
  WHERE m.n >= 24 AND n.temp_mean_c IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.station_name AS x_axis, d.diff AS data
FROM d
JOIN ref.weather_station s USING (station_id)
WHERE s.county_code = :county
ORDER BY data DESC, x_axis
